lines: You made it sound like spending time with me was a chore.
I was actually looking forward to seeing you. So... yeah, that stung.

choices.text: I was being a jerk. I'm sorry.
I didn't think you'd take it so seriously.

lines: I just didn't want to feel stupid for wanting you here.
Thanks for saying it. We can take things slow, alright?
If you're not in the mood, just say so. Don't make me feel like I'm wasting your time.
